root.label: Erroneous behaviour and C++26
root.note: P2795's new category of defined-but-wrong behaviour, plus the C++26 rules that turn old traps into errors.

children.label: Erroneous behaviour
children.note: Well-defined behaviour that is always a bug and that implementations are recommended to diagnose.

children.label: Not undefined
children.note: The optimizer cannot assume it never happens; the program may be diagnosed or terminated.

children.label: Never in constexpr
children.note: An evaluation that would be erroneous is not a core constant expression.

children.label: Uninitialized storage
children.note: [basic.indet] now separates erroneous values from indeterminate ones.

children.label: Automatic variables
children.note: Start with erroneous values fixed by the implementation; reading one is erroneous behaviour.

children.label: new and [[indeterminate]]
children.note: Heap memory and opted-out variables start indeterminate; reading them is still UB.

children.label: Static storage
children.note: Static and thread-local variables are still zero-initialized.

children.label: GCC 16 picks zero
children.note: In C++26 mode, automatic variables are zero-filled unless -ftrivial-auto-var-init says otherwise.

children.label: Newly ill-formed
children.note: Patterns that were bugs, often UB, now rejected at compile time.

children.label: Return to temporary
children.note: P2748: a return that binds the result reference to a temporary is an error.

children.label: delete incomplete type
children.note: P3144: deleting a pointer to an incomplete class no longer compiles.

children.label: Enum arithmetic
children.note: P2864: enum with other enum or floating type is ill-formed; GCC 16 only warns.

children.label: Array comparison
children.note: P2865: comparing two arrays with == or < is ill-formed.

children.label: New conveniences
children.note: Small language additions aimed at clearer code and diagnostics.

children.label: Placeholder _
children.note: P2169: may be declared repeatedly in a scope, but a use after the second is ambiguous.

children.label: delete with reason
children.note: P2573: = delete("message") puts the message in the compiler's error.

children.label: static_assert messages
children.note: P2741: any constant with size() and data(), evaluated only on failure.

children.label: Binding conditions
children.note: P0963: if (auto [a, b] = e) tests the whole object converted to bool.

children.label: #embed
children.note: P1967: includes a binary file as a list of integer literals.

children.label: Other changes
children.note: Deprecations, loosened rules and a removal.

children.label: Ellipsis comma
children.note: P3176: void f(int...) is deprecated; write void f(int, ...).

children.label: Trivial infinite loops
children.note: P2809: while (true); is no longer UB; it behaves as repeated yield calls.

children.label: Trivial relocation removed
children.note: P2786 was adopted in 2025, then removed by P3920 in November 2025; not in N5050.
